roles.name: Gun Tank
powers: When you play an armor to reduce damage dealt to you, reduce it by an additional 1 (☐ 3).
At the end of your turn, you may recharge (☐ or shuffle into your deck) a buried weapon that has the Firearm trait (☐ or a buried armor).
☐ Gain the skill Craft: Intelligence +3 (☐ and the skill Melee: Strength +3).
☐ Reduce damage dealt to a character at your location by 1 (☐ or by 3 if the damage is dealt by a bane before a character acts).
☐ At the start of your turn, you may recharge a card; if you do, you may draw a card. (☐ You may then recharge a random card from your discard pile.)
☐ On your check to defeat a barrier that has the Lock, Obstacle, or Trap trait, you may bury an armor to add 1d12; if you defeat the barrier, you may explore again.

roles.name: Living Cannon
powers: When you play an armor to reduce damage dealt to you, reduce it by an additional 1 (☐ 3).

At the end of your turn, you may recharge a buried weapon that has the Firearm trait (☐ or a buried armor). (☐ Then if none of the cards in your hand have the Firearm trait, you may recharge your hand.)
☐ Gain the skill Craft: Intelligence +3. (☐ Add 1d12 to your check to acquire or recharge a card that has the Ammunition trait.)
☐ When you display a card that has the Ammunition trait for its power, you may draw a card.
☐ You may recharge a card to add 1d4 (☐ +1) to a combat check by a character at another location.

☐ For the first exploration of your turn, you may examine the top 2 (☐ or 3) cards of your location deck. Choose 1 to encounter; you must choose a monster if you found any. Then shuffle the rest of the deck.
